title: Noor and the Playlist
author: Yara Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Delacroix, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
